label: The relation-of-reason account: cost, real decrees under N, and a joint model
paraphrase: Analyst certificate, attribution deferred. (1) On the relation-of-reason account (an invariant intrinsic profile, a real determination carrying the act, the act's actual terminus the effect, every terminus existing, the effect CONTINGENT_1), the act is performed at every accessible world and does not strictly suffice for the effect; no fact intrinsic to the source (in the sense of IntrinsicTo, DEF f8bd9e72: agreement with w at every accessible world where the source has exactly its actual determinations; this admits necessarily true extrinsic predicates and is not membership in Has) discriminates the effect's presence from its absence; the act's terminus discriminates it and is not intrinsic to the source. Facts that are neither intrinsic nor the terminus are not ranged over. (2) For a real, exclusive decree family under N at one bearer (no accessible world gives it a determination it lacks), every decree of that family it has at an accessible world is its actual decree; if that decree suffices for a contingent effect, some accessible world lacks the effect and has no decree of the family. A different decree of the family is excluded; extra effects under the same decree are not. (3) On one finite carrier the account holds together with RootPurity, a30c5963, N at the root, 0c8631bd, both directions of member grounding (by definition of the carrier's admissibility), the existential PSR for contingents (through the stipulated reason relation only), some actual contingent concrete being, the failure of actual collapse and #555's IX.6/IsImmutable/ModalCapacity readings at the actual world, with creature potency restored: the effect is in potency to the impure limiter. A structural surrogate only; nothing in the account mentions intellect.
